why: April Fools tour-joke items can look either like member-staged fakes or reactions to an official Daft Punk joke, and the concepts often only show circulation and recognition.

why.T3-005: The item has attackers, covering, takeover and griefing ('trying to ruin', 'about to get covered', 'taken over') plus calls to defend or seek reinforcements, so the attack-and-fight gate leads.
why.T3-021: It also carries ongoing protection and cleaning of the artwork and lattice (keep lattice alive, clean vandalism, protected to the end) with no fight as the point, so the upkeep gate is distinct.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-005's attack-and-fight gate does not reach the cleaning, barrier upkeep and protected-to-the-end reports that are not a called fight.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1262353 and C1134393 show the room keeping the work clean and protected as an ongoing watch, satisfying T3-021's watching-and-repairing gate.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-021; dropping it would lose the repair and upkeep side of keeping the pixel art alive.

why.T3-006: Calls and agreements target rival marks for wiping out, kicking out, destroying or covering Georgia Tech, the black-and-yellow mark or UVA, which is the attack-on-rivals gate rather than ordinary recruitment.

why.T3-153: The item is contact and coordination with another room through chat: greeting r/liquicity, teaming on both logos, and directing helpers to Liquicity's Discord.

why.T3-039: r/samuraijack asks Fox Stevenson to let Aku be rebuilt and the logo go elsewhere, and the offered help after Aku goes shows yielding room or space in response to a neighbour's request.

why.T3-070: Concepts circulate buildable directions for the logo: stem-only simplification, text placement, and pixel art for placers to copy.

why.T3-056: The H3H3 collaboration, combined Daft Punk X H3H3 X Greenlattice presentation, and Daft Fupa naming are rooms making or displaying one joint mark.
why.T3-014: C0077456 invites builders to the Discord chat, a move of coordination to a chat outside the thread.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-056 carries the joint H3H3/Greenlattice mark but not the separate move of builders into the Discord chat.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0077456 posts the Discord invite for the room's r/place build, satisfying T3-014's chat-coordination gate.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-014; dropping it loses only the off-thread Discord venue while the joint-mark practice remains.

why.T3-009: Finished Daft Punk, Guy-Man and Thomas work is marked achieved with 'WE DID IT', pride and thanks; this is celebration rather than progress reporting or crediting alone.

why.T3-001: The sub circulates and calls out a false Daft Punk tour or Alive announcement as April Fools bait, members almost fall for and warn about it, matching member-staged fake news and reveal rather than a known official joke.

why.T3-073: The single retrospective line reports what happened to the unfinished build—time ran out and only half a logo remains—rather than celebrating a finished work or mourning its loss.

why.T3-188: Organised r/polska participants separate their Discord or plan from uncontrolled Polish placers: cannot speak for every member, random outsiders removing the road, no coordinated expansion, and false-flag or outside-sub denial.

why.T3-022: The build abandons occupied coordinates because Samurai Jack rebuilds there, tries a third location, notices another build at the second, and cites insufficient space and manpower: relocation after losing or being squeezed out.

why.T3-015: The concepts create and enforce one r/place megathread and redirect other r/place posts to it.

why.T3-001: This duplicate of the same April Fools tour-joke block also circulates and calls out the false Daft Punk tour or Alive announcement as member-staged April Fools bait, with hedging, warning and almost falling for it.

why.T3-010: Most concepts negotiate what and where with neighbours: Greenlattice permit and placement under Guy, Steve Irwin/r_straya deal, avoiding Majora, side-by-side move with protection, and letting Australians have the area.

why.T3-002: Repeated calls ask fellow robots to help make or represent Daft Punk pixel art, start pieces, finish Thomas, and send reinforcements, matching calls to the room's own members and placers.
